name: Cervo Hotel, Costa Smeralda Resort
insider_take: Perched on Costa Smeralda's legendary coastline, this isn't just a hotel—it's your gateway to the Italian Riviera's most exclusive playground where billionaire yachts and pristine beaches create pure Mediterranean magic.
whats_special: Located in the heart of Porto Cervo, the glamorous capital of Costa Smeralda created by the Aga Khan in the 1960s. The hotel sits mere steps from the world-famous Porto Cervo Marina, where superyachts worth millions dock during the summer season. The surrounding Costa Smeralda boasts some of Sardinia's most pristine beaches with powdery white sand and emerald waters that inspired the region's name.
pro_tip: Book a sunset aperitivo on the hotel terrace during late July or August when the marina is packed with luxury yachts and the jet-set crowd is in full swing—it's when Porto Cervo truly comes alive.
dont_miss: A stroll through Porto Cervo's designer boutiques along the famous Piazzetta, followed by a day trip to nearby Spiaggia del Principe beach (once Prince Aga Khan's private retreat) or the iconic Pevero Beach. The weekly Porto Cervo market offers authentic Sardinian crafts and local delicacies just minutes from your door.
pros: Prime location in exclusive Porto Cervo with stunning Costa Smeralda views
Authentic Sardinian architecture and Mediterranean design
Direct access to pristine beaches and crystal-clear waters
Luxury amenities with Marriott Luminous Program benefits
cons: Premium pricing reflecting exclusive Costa Smeralda location
